label: FUS::ATF1

sections.text: FUS encodes an RNA-binding protein involved in RNA processing and transcriptional regulation.
ATF1 encodes a CREB-family transcription factor responsive to cyclic-AMP signaling.

The fusion combines a FET-family activation region with a CREB-family DNA-binding region, producing abnormal transcriptional activation. FUS::ATF1 is a recognized fusion in angiomatoid fibrous histiocytoma.
